name: Devin
tagline: Devin is Cognition AI's autonomous software agent, marketed as the world's first AI software engineer. Given a task, Devin opens a terminal, writes and runs code, browses the web for documentation, and iterates until the problem is solved — without human hand-holding. It targets engineering teams who want to delegate complete, well-scoped tasks rather than just get code suggestions.
